none: PAS LIN-79C814: LIN-79C814: Roman nummus of the House of Valentinian

An incomplete Roman copper-alloy nummus, possibly of the House of Valentinian, dating to the period c. AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Probably GLORIA ROMANORVM reverse type depicting the Emperor advancing right holding standard and dragging captive. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Illegible. Obverse inscription: [ ... ]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding standard and dragging…
